idd.screen_scope.quote: Lists covered: the UN Security Council consolidated list, the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals list, US State Department designations, the Swiss SECO sanctions list, and the World Bank and Global Fund debarment and ineligibility lists.
idd.screen_scope.note: Full scope stated in prose. The pack rule is text_must_include over canonical tokens (un, ofac, us-state, switzerland, debarment, ineligibility); prose such as "UN Security Council" or "Swiss SECO" does not literally contain us-state/switzerland tokens, so a literal token matcher would fail although the scope is complete.

rule.title: Restrictive Measures scope must attest UN, OFAC, US State, Switzerland, and debarment
